title: 防災工学Ⅰ
subtitle: Disaster Prevention Engineering I
teachers:
MIYAZATO Shinichi
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1) gain basic knowledge concerning maintenance of infrastructures, to keep them safe in a sustainable manner.
(2) learn maintenance methods for concrete structures.
advice:
This is a basic course on the maintenance of infrastructures. We will cover the following topics:

1. Maintenance systems
2. Life cycle design
3. Deterioration mechanisms and countermeasures for concrete
(chloride attack, carbonation, ASR, frost damage)

Students are required to actively participate in class.
Students are expected to bring their textbook and other necessary materials to every class.

This is useful preparation for Civil and Environmental Engineering Major Lab/Exercises.

[Textbook]

requiredKnowledge:
Students must have knowledge of Environmental Materials and Reinforced Concrete.
They must also be acquainted with density and the concentration of a solution.

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Fully understand the situation of aging Japanese infrastructures.
(2) Fully construct scheme of maintenance according to environment.
(3) Appropriately judge deterioration of concrete structure and propose repair method.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Understand the situation of aging infrastructures in the Hokuriku region.
(2) Explain the necessities of maintenance.
(3) Explain the deterioration of concrete structures and methods for repairing them.
